title: Today's work & standard staff sidebar
note: Appointments only, with collection actions. No Follow-up section or duplicate page shortcuts. Native Payload groups show Clients, Courts and Employers; supported extension links handle collection, booking, tracker and payment.

title: Review client & appointment
note: Keep the original simple review layout with a compact headshot/name/DOB row. Identity checks, headshot capture and occasional client/test/referral edits remain. No medication or payment recap here.

title: Choose, change or register client
note: Conditional detour only; this example changes an already linked client. An unlinked booking shows no assumed client header. Search candidates by headshot/name/DOB before linking; registration’s five existing internal steps remain unchanged.

title: Payment — client owes
note: The original payment layout is retained. No payment entered yet; continuing with debt uses the existing acknowledgement. No medication/result panels on this step.

title: Payment — prepaid
note: No payment needed, $0 remaining, Add account credit collapsed. Any older client debt must remain visible. Payment is not repeated on later steps.

title: Payment — bill referral ON
note: Simple per-test switch: referral owes the test, client owes zero for this test. This is invoice responsibility, not a paid status; backend proposal 007 must precede implementation.

title: Payment — bill referral OFF
note: The client pays this exception. Preserve normal payment controls; exclude even an unpaid/partial exception from referral invoices.

title: Generate & upload report
note: Client header plus the two generate/upload tasks only. No medication content. Waiting for PDF appears once; returning from ToxAccess never proves generation.

title: Prepare lab collection
note: Client header, donor/test code and ToxAccess preparation. No medication panel, instant PDF requirement or inferred lab result.

title: Review report data
note: One PDF reference, match status and small result strip. Optional extraction details collapse; actual parse/name warnings and acknowledgements remain visible. Classification remains provisional until medication verification.

title: Verify medications
note: One active medication list with configured expectations and add/edit/discontinue actions. No medication images, duplicate list or duplicated result summary.

title: Verify instant test — simple result & decision
note: One small labeled result strip and the existing short decision choices. Optional test editing is collapsed; required confirmation choices and errors stay accessible. This example has expected AMP and unexpected THC.

title: Confirm lab collection
note: Brief collection summary, optional editing collapsed. Validation opens affected controls when needed. No lab screening result exists yet.

title: Review instant result & recipients
note: Only client/result context repeats. No medication, payment or full details recap. Keep recipients, report attachment and preview. The initial unexpected-positive screen is distinct from the pending final result.

title: Review collection notification
note: Simple referral collection notification review. No repeated payment/medication details, client result email or result PDF attachment.

title: Collection saved
note: Show actual saved-record and notification outcome. Awaiting lab results is not negative. Keep next appointment/schedule actions; do not repeat payment to retry a failed receipt/email.

title: Client summary — retained design
note: The client design you liked is retained. Medication information appears once. Full paginated history, reports, client balance, account credit, referral-owned debt and payment history remain accessible; no staff Delete.

title: Referral summary — retained design
note: The referral design you liked is retained. Contacts, preferred test and linked clients are digestible. Summary/Edit use Payload document tabs; any restriction of advanced billing settings is a separately reviewed access change.

title: Collect payment — independent of a test
note: Select/verify a client, enter payment and receipt, optional allocation details collapsed. No medication/result panel or fake appointment. Cash example; account-level Terminal card support needs a separate backend contract.
